== Editing ==
English Decipher publication comparison. Highlights mark the changes.

Reflections Gold: [[Flagship Operations (Reflections Gold)]] is an unpublished playtest text of the cancelled [[Reflections Gold]] set (Decipher, 2001); it has its own column, labelled as such. Its highlights mark words that differ from the published column before it. The next published column is still compared with that published column, not with the playtest.
